objective: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

description: Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.
Show them your trophy, and bask in the glory...
progress: The Sentinels do what they can here in Ashenvale, but it's thanks to <race>s like you that we have gained the ground we have.
completion: So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in Ashenvale?
I am more than pleased with your abilities, <name>. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.
I shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.
